title: 夕ぐれシャッター
concept: 池のほとりの生き物は、動く直前に「気配」を見せる。カエルののどがふくらむ、水面に輪が立つ、カワセミが首をふる。前ぶれを観察して決定的瞬間にシャッターを切る写真ゲーム。画面に入らない場所の出来事は音の左右で知らせ、日が傾くにつれ光と顔ぶれが変わる。
howToPlay: ドラッグで池のまわりを見回し、右下のボタンで撮影する。動きの頂点を写すほど高得点。フィルム15枚、日が暮れるまで。
libraryDecision: 使わない。面白さの核は「前ぶれを見て、一瞬を待って撮る」観察とタイミングで、物理演算や3Dで強まる部分がない。2Dの描画で生き物の小さな前ぶれ（のど・波紋・しっぽ）がはっきり見え、撮った写真もそのまま画面から切り取れる。
soundDecision: BGMは付けず、池の環境音そのものを手がかりにした。カエルの鳴き声、カワセミの「ピーッ」、コイが跳ぶ前のぽこぽこ、リスの葉ずれ、シカの小枝の音、フクロウの声を、画面の外なら左右に振って小さく鳴らす。音の方へ見回すと何かが起きている。昼は小鳥、日暮れは虫の声に変わり、時間の流れも耳で分かる。シャッター音と、決定的瞬間を撮れたときの短いチャイムで手応えを返す。

candidates.idea: 夕暮れの池で、生き物が動く前の「気配」を観察してシャッターを切る写真ゲーム。画面外の出来事は音の左右で分かる。
candidates.ideaEn: A photography game at a pond at dusk: read the tell before each creature moves and press the shutter at the peak. Off-screen events are heard from left or right.

candidates.idea: たこあげ。指で糸を引く・ゆるめるで風に乗せ、電線や木をよけながらどこまで高く上げられるか。
candidates.ideaEn: Kite flying: pull and slacken the string with your finger to ride the wind, dodging wires and trees to climb as high as you can.

candidates.idea: 掲示板はがし。重なって貼られた紙を1枚ずつはがし、画びょうを抜く順番を間違えると全部落ちる。
candidates.ideaEn: Notice-board peeling: peel overlapping papers one at a time; pull the pins in the wrong order and everything falls.

en.title: Golden Hour Shutter
en.concept: Creatures by the pond give a tell just before they move: a frog puffs its throat, rings rise on the water, a kingfisher bobs its head. Read the tell and press the shutter at the decisive moment. Events outside the frame are heard from left or right, and as the sun sets the light and the cast change.
en.howToPlay: Drag to look around the pond and tap the button at the bottom right to shoot. Catch the peak of the action for big points. 15 shots, until night falls.
en.libraryDecision: No libraries. The fun is observing a tell and timing one shot, which physics or 3D would not strengthen. Plain 2D canvas shows the small tells (throat, ripples, tail) clearly, and photos are cut straight from the screen.
en.soundDecision: No music: the pond itself is the clue. The frog croak, the kingfisher whistle, the bubbling before a koi leaps, rustling leaves, a deer snapping a twig and the owl hoot are panned left or right and quieter when off-screen, so turning toward a sound finds something happening. Daytime birdsong turns into evening crickets so you hear time passing, and a shutter click plus a short chime on a perfect moment give feedback.

aiReview.comment: 生き物ごとの前ぶれ（のどがふくらむ、水面の輪、しっぽ、首ふり）を見つけて待ち、跳ねた頂点を撮れたときの「撮れた！」は気持ちいい。撮った写真がそのままポラロイドで出て、最後にアルバムで並ぶのも満足感がある。夕焼けから夜へ変わる景色と、フクロウ・ホタルなど時間で増える顔ぶれも良い。一方で、生き物が画面に対して小さく写真の主役感が弱い、1回のプレイで9種すべて撮れてしまい図鑑の目標がすぐ尽きる、上下に見回す指の向きを2回逆にしてしまった（地図と同じ向きだが、カメラだと逆に感じる）。カエルは気配の段階で撮ってしまい、跳ぶのはその直後だった。くり返し遊ぶ理由は点数のベスト更新だけで、ふつう寄りの面白さ。

similar.title: Pokémon Snap / New Pokémon Snap
similar.note: 生き物の写真を撮り、ポーズ（動き）・大きさ・中央への配置で採点される点がルーツ。違いは、決まったレールを進まず自分で見回すこと、動く前の「前ぶれ」を読む待ちのタイミングと音の左右を中心にしたこと。
similar.note_en: The root: photograph creatures and get scored on pose/action, size and centering. Differences: no on-rails ride, you look around yourself, and the core is reading the tell before a move and hearing sounds left or right.

similar.title: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure
similar.note: 自然の中で野生動物を撮って図鑑を埋める。違いは、探索や保護の物語がなく、1つの池で数分間の一瞬を狙う点数ゲームであること。
similar.note_en: Photograph wildlife to fill a field guide. Differences: no exploration or conservation story; a few-minute score game about catching moments at one pond.

similar.title: TOEM
similar.note: カメラで景色の中の生き物や出来事を見つける遊び。違いは、謎解き・旅ではなく、時間と枚数の中での動きのタイミング勝負であること。
similar.note_en: Finding creatures and events in a scene with a camera. Differences: not puzzles and travel, but timing action within a time and film limit.

aiReview.research: WebSearchで「Pokemon Snap photo scoring pose timing」「Toem / Umurangi Generation photography game wildlife」「Alba: A Wildlife Adventure」を検索し、生き物撮影ゲームの採点のしかたと題材を比べた。

en.comment: Spotting each creature's tell (puffing throat, rings on the water, swishing tail, bobbing head), waiting, and catching the top of a leap feels great, and each photo popping out as a polaroid then lining up in an album at the end is satisfying. The shift from sunset to night and the new arrivals over time (owl, fireflies) are nice. But creatures are small in the frame so photos lack a strong subject, all 9 species can be shot in a single run so the field guide runs out fast, and I dragged the wrong way twice when looking up or down (map-style dragging feels reversed for a camera). I shot the frog during its tell and it jumped right after. The only reason to replay is a new best score; fun, but on the average side.
en.research: Searched the web for Pokémon Snap's scoring (pose, timing), TOEM / Umurangi Generation, and Alba: A Wildlife Adventure to compare scoring and themes of creature photography games.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 29 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 29 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: タップで開始。昼の池が見える。HUDに点数とフィルム15枚
playLog.noteEn: Tapped to start. A daytime pond; HUD shows score and 15 shots of film

playLog.note: 中央近くにトンボ。止まっているように見えたのでそのまま撮る
playLog.noteEn: A dragonfly near the center, seemingly hovering, so I shoot right away

playLog.note: 左に何か緑のものが見えたので見回す
playLog.noteEn: Something green on the left; pan over to look

playLog.note: カエルののどがふくらんでいる＝跳ぶ前ぶれ。中央に寄せて少し待ってから撮影
playLog.noteEn: The frog's throat is puffing — the tell before a jump. Centered it, waited a beat, then shot

playLog.note: カエルは気配の段階で撮ってしまい、跳んだのはその後だった。右下の水面に輪が立っている——コイの前ぶれ。寄せて待つ
playLog.noteEn: I shot the frog too early, during its tell; it jumped right after. Rings on the water at lower right — a koi's tell. Centered it and waited

playLog.note: コイの跳ねる頂点が撮れて★3。右の方を見回す
playLog.noteEn: Caught the koi at the top of its leap for 3 stars. Panning right

playLog.note: 右のカエルは休憩中。さらに右、葦の向こうを見る
playLog.noteEn: The frog on the right is resting. Looking further right past the reeds

playLog.note: カワセミが魚をくわえて水から上がってくるところ！すぐ撮る
playLog.noteEn: A kingfisher rising from the water with a fish! Shoot at once

playLog.note: 頂点は少し過ぎていて「動いた！」止まり。左下の方を見に行く
playLog.noteEn: Slightly past the peak, so only 'In action'. Heading to the lower left

playLog.note: 上下にはほとんど動かない。左の木と岩の方へ
playLog.noteEn: The view barely moves up or down. Heading left toward the tree and rock

playLog.note: 岩の上にねこ。リスのいる枝の葉は画面の一番上、点数表示の裏に隠れてしまう
playLog.noteEn: A cat on the rock. The squirrel's leaves sit at the very top of the screen, behind the score display

playLog.note: リスがどんぐりを持って顔を出した。ただ画面の上端でこれ以上上に見回せない。はみ出し覚悟で撮る
playLog.noteEn: A squirrel popped out with an acorn, but it is at the top edge and I cannot look higher. Shooting anyway

playLog.note: 「はみだし」と判定。ねこのしっぽを見張る
playLog.noteEn: Judged 'cut off'. Watching the cat's tail

playLog.note: まだ動かない。もう少し待つ
playLog.noteEn: No movement yet. Waiting a bit longer

playLog.note: ねこが大あくび！すぐ撮影
playLog.noteEn: The cat is mid-yawn! Shoot

playLog.note: あくびの瞬間で★2。小枝の音がした気がして右端の岸へ
playLog.noteEn: Got the yawn for 2 stars. Heading to the far right bank

playLog.note: シカが水を飲んでいる。カワセミも同じ画面に。顔を上げるのを待つ
playLog.noteEn: A deer drinking, with the kingfisher in the same frame. Waiting for the deer to lift its head

playLog.note: カワセミは魚をくわえて枝に。シカはまだ飲んでいる
playLog.noteEn: The kingfisher is on its perch with a fish. The deer is still drinking

playLog.note: シカが顔を上げた！少し中央へ寄せて撮影
playLog.noteEn: The deer looked up! Nudged it toward center and shot

playLog.note: シカの見上げた瞬間で★3。空が夕焼けに。左の大きな木へ戻って待つ
playLog.noteEn: 3 stars for the deer looking up. The sky turns to sunset. Back to the big tree on the left to wait

playLog.note: 木のうろの前で日暮れを待つ
playLog.noteEn: Waiting for dusk in front of the tree hollow

playLog.note: たそがれ。うろからフクロウが顔を出している。首をかしげるのを待つ
playLog.noteEn: Twilight. An owl peers from the hollow. Waiting for it to tilt its head

playLog.note: 上へも少し見回せた。フクロウを中央に。もう少し待つ
playLog.noteEn: I could look up a little after all. Owl centered; waiting a bit more

playLog.note: 右上にリスも出てきた。フクロウとリスを一緒に撮る（さっき上に見回せなかったのは指の向きを逆にしていたからだった）
playLog.noteEn: The squirrel appeared top right too. Shooting the owl and squirrel together (earlier I could not look up because I dragged the wrong way)

playLog.note: フクロウは「ふつう」でも★3（たそがれの光の分も加点）。池の葦の方へホタルを探しに
playLog.noteEn: The owl scored 3 stars even as 'casual' (twilight bonus). Off to the pond reeds to look for fireflies

playLog.note: また指の向きを逆にして空を見上げた。三日月と星。足もとにホタルの光が見えるので下へ
playLog.noteEn: Dragged the wrong way again and looked at the sky: a crescent moon and stars. Firefly glow at the bottom, so heading down

playLog.note: 葦のまわりにホタルが光る。ねこ・カエルも入れて夜の池を一枚
playLog.noteEn: Fireflies glow around the reeds. One night shot of the pond with the cat and frog in it

playLog.note: 右の水面に輪。夜のコイを狙う
playLog.noteEn: Rings on the water to the right. Going for a koi at night

playLog.note: 残り10秒。適当に1枚撮って、日暮れの終わりまで待つ
playLog.noteEn: 10 seconds left. One casual shot, then wait for nightfall
